title: EVITA - Epcoritamab plus Venetoclax plus Ibrutinib in patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with TP53 Alterations
official: EVITA - Epcoritamab plus Venetoclax plus Ibrutinib in patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with TP53 Alterations
summary: Main objective: To assess the efficacy of the combination of epcoritamab, venetoclax and ibrutinib (EVI) in treatment-naïve SLL or CLL subjects with TP53 alterations
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Subject (or their legally acceptable representative/trusted person) who understood and voluntarily signed and dated an informed consent form prior to any trial-specific assessments/procedures being conducted
2. 10. Adequate hematopoietic function within 7 days before the subject’s enrollment   • ANC ≥ 1 G/L  • And Platelets ≥ 50 G/L  • And Hemoglobin ≥ 8 g/dL
3. 11. Adequate renal function defined by a Creatinine Clearance ≥ 50 ml/min   calculated according to MDRD or CKD-EPI or Cockcroft-Gault (using actual body weight).
4. 12. Adequate liver function, as indicated by a total bilirubin <1.5 x ULN, AST  and ALT <3 x ULN value, unless directly attributed to the participant’s  CLL/SLL or to Gilbert’s Syndrome (the ULN is based on institutional values)
5. 13. The subject must have been vaccinated against pneumococcal (< 5 years) and SARS-CoV-2 (< 1 year) with at least 21 days between the last vaccination and the subject’s enrollment
6. 14. Woman of childbearing potential (WOCBP):   - should have a negative result for pregnancy test (minimum sensitivity of 25 mIU/mL, urine or serum), within 28 days prior the subject’s enrollment - should agree to use 1 form of highly effective method of contraception from the time of screening until at least 12 months after the final dose of epcoritamab, or at least 3 months after the final dose of ibrutinib or at least 30 days after the final dose of venetoclax, whichever is the longest
7. 15. Woman should agree to abstain from breastfeeding during trial participation
8. 16. Woman should agree to perform further pregnancy testing monthly
9. 17. Woman should agree not to donate eggs (ova, oocytes) for the purposes of  assisted reproduction during the entire trial
10. 18. Man of reproductive potential should agree to use an acceptable method of birth control during treatment . Men should agree not to donate sperm during the entire trial
11. 19. Subject covered by any social security system (France)
12. 2. Must be able to adhere to the trial visit schedule and other protocol requirements
13. 20. Subject who understands and speaks one of the country official languages unless local regulation authorizes independent translators
14. 21. Life expectancy > 6 months
15. 3. Age between ≥ 18 years and < 80 years at the time of signing the informed consent form (ICF)
16. 4. Cumulative Illness Rating Score (CIRS) ≤ 6
17. 5. CD20+, untreated and documented CLL or SLL, with a Royal Marsden Hospital (RMH) or Matutes Score > 3. For SLL a detectable clone with a CLL phenotype in the peripheral blood is a prerequisite for trial participation.
18. 6. Presence of TP53 abnormalities (either 17p deletion by FISH and/or TP53 mutations) according to ERIC recommandations
19. 7. Subject requiring treatment according to 2018 iwCLL guidelines
20. 8. Presence of measurable disease (absolute lymphocyte count > 5,000/μL, palpable or measurable lymph node ≥1.5cm on imaging, or bone marrow involvement
21. 9. ECOG performance status 0 to 2
Exclusion criteria:
1. Any prior CLL or SLL-specific therapies, even including rituximab used for autoimmune cytopenias
2. History of stroke or intracranial hemorrhage within 6 months prior to ICF signature.
3. Major surgery anticipated before the ICF signature
4. Known bleeding disorders
5. Active Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) infection (RNA PCR-positive). Subject who received treatment for HCV infection that was intended to eradicate the   virus may participate if hepatitis C RNA levels are undetectable
6. Active Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) infection (DNA PCR-positive). Subject with evidence of prior HBV infection but who are PCR-negative are permitted in the trial but should receive prophylactic antiviral therapy during the entire   treatment with active monitoring of viral load in the blood
7. Known history of seropositivity for HIV infection
8. Known or suspected hypersensitivity or anaphylaxis to trial intervention(s) including active substance or to any of the excipients.
9. Requires treatment with warfarin, other vitamin K antagonists, or dual   antiplatelet therapy
10. Requires treatment with a strong cytochrome CYP3A4 inhibitor/inducer
11. Vaccinated with live, attenuated vaccines within 6 months of enrollment
12. Clinically significant cardiovascular disease including the following:   a. Myocardial infarction within 6 months prior to ICF signature   b. Unstable angina within 3 months prior to ICF signature   c. NYHA class III or IV heart failure   d. Uncontrolled hypertension   e. History of clinically significant arrhythmias (including sustained   ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, or torsades de pointes).   f. QTcF > 480 msec using the Fridericia formula   g. History of Mobitz II second- or third-degree heart block without permanent pacemaker   h. LVEF <50% as determined by echocardiography or multiple uptake gated acquisition (MUGA) scan
13. Participation in another clinical study who would compromise the   participation to the current study.
14. Use of any standard or experimental anti-cancer drug therapy within 28   days or 5 half-lives (whichever is shorter) before the subject’s enrollment
15. Any prior therapy with a bispecific antibody targeting CD3 and CD20
16. Prior allogeneic stem cells or autologous transplant.
17. Pregnant, planning to become pregnant or lactating woman
18. Any significant medical conditions, or laboratory abnormality or psychiatric illness likely to interfere with participation in this clinical trial (according to  the investigator’s decision)
19. Ongoing active bacterial, viral, fungal, mycobacterial, parasitic or other   infection requiring systemic treatment (excluding prophylactic treatment) at the time of enrollment or within the previous 2 weeks prior to the first dose of trial drug, including COVID-19 infection and participants with positive   cytomegalovirus PCR.
20. Subject deprived of their liberty by a judicial or administrative decision
21. Subject hospitalized without consent
22. Adult subject under legal protection
23. Child-Pugh liver cirrhosis.
24. Clinical evidence for Central Nervous System involvement by CLL
25. History of ongoing or confirmed Progressive Multifocal   Leukoencephalopathy (PML).
26. Active autoimmune disease or other disease requiring permanent   immunosuppressive treatment including steroids therapy > 20mg daily of prednisone dose or equivalent within 15 days prior subject's enrollment
27. Active, uncontrolled autoimmune hemolytic anemia or idiopathic   thrombocytopenic purpura, requiring steroid therapy with > 20 mg daily of prednisone dose or equivalent within 15 days prior subject's enrollment
28. Any prior history of Richter transformation or DLBCL
29. Active malignancy other than the one treated in this trial. Prior history of  malignancies unless the subject has been free of the disease for ≥ 2 years. However, subjects with the following history /conditions that have been   treated with a curative intent are allowed:   a. Non-invasive basal cell or epidermoid carcinoma (non melanoma)   b. In situ carcinoma of the cervix   c. In situ carcinoma of the breast   d. Incidental histologic finding of prostate cancer (T1a or T1b) using the   tumor, nodes, metastasis [TNM] clinical staging system   Woman with adjuvant endocrine therapy (I.e., hormonotherapy) after breast cancer treatment can be enrolled if hormonotherapy was started for ≥ 2   years
